name: Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR)
evidence: The official About Us page identifies IGIDR as an advanced research institute, says it was registered as an autonomous society and public trust, and states that it was recognized as a Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act.
notes: Normal HTTPS verification encountered the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used for public GET attempts.
